data_handling: No case identifiers, patient values, reporter values, credentials, or saved query contents are included. Search inputs were left blank.

observations: Field labels are section-scoped; repeated labels such as First Name(English), Country Code and Title remain distinct by section.
A required asterisk was observed on nine fields; this records the UI marker, not a verified backend validation rule.
The Product Name(English) field has a visible required marker while its textbox is disabled in the observed state.
The Activity Log table showed 0 of 0 rows. No add, search, save, submit, reset, lookup or form-variant action was performed.

All 25 dropdown controls within the selected Adverse Event form were opened and closed without selecting a value. Country Code (Reporter and Patient) and Formulation Code exposed a Search textbox; their complete option values are intentionally not stored.
General Inquiry and Medical Inquiry each showed nine dropdown fields: General Info (2), Reporter (5), Product (1), Medical Information (1).
MI with AE showed the Adverse Event dropdown sections plus Medical Information > Found Answer; its shared option lists are deduplicated by option-set reference.

Product Quality Complaint showed 11 dropdown fields, including Product Complaint Classification Code, Product Complaint Category Code, and Status Code under Product Complaint Details; its visible form did not include Patient or Event Information sections.
Country Code and Formulation Code Search controls were confirmed across the inspected variants. Large option lists remain count/search metadata, not full stored values.

dropdown_inventory.runtime_selection_guidance: Open the field dropdown, fill its Search textbox with the exact value supplied by the test case, select only one exact matching option, then verify the selected label. Treat zero or multiple matches as unresolved; do not guess.

variant_dropdown_maps.inspection_note: The combined form showed the Adverse Event dropdown sections plus Medical Information > Found Answer; shared option sets reference the already inspected sets.

schema_notes: This catalog stores visible labels, section relationships, control kinds, required-marker visibility, current enabled state, placeholders and option-list status; it intentionally omits DOM tags, Angular internals, CSS selectors and implementation-specific IDs.
required_marker_observed=false means no visible asterisk was observed; it does not prove a field is optional in server validation.

Counts for searchable option lists describe the options visible when inspected. Large searchable lists are not embedded and should be refreshed from the live product catalog when a plan needs a value.
